ingest.json.latency_note: One sample per request at its final outcome of any status (202, 4xx, 5xx, timeout or transport error, 429 retries exhausted). latency_from_schedule runs from the request's scheduled due time to its final response, retry waits and dispatch lag included: judge API latency targets on it. dispatch_lag is the final send minus the scheduled time and service_latency the final attempt's send to response, so latency_from_schedule is about dispatch_lag plus service_latency.
